summary: Iteration 3 covered the P0 upload-503 bug fix (Emergent Object Storage) and Phase 2 Jeevant Darshan live-wallpaper engine. Backend: 14/15 pytest cases passed; upload now returns 200 with a real object-storage URL, /api/files/{path} serves the same bytes back, uploaded URLs can be attached to wallpapers and appear on the public feed with Phase 2 metadata (isLive/animationPreset/animationConfig/qualityDefault/type). Frontend: all requested testIDs render on the external EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — LIVE/STATIC badges (11 live, 12 static), Jeevant Darshan · Live section, detail-preview, detail-apply honest sheet (does NOT claim success, correctly says Phase 2 native build needed), live-preview-screen + live-preview-apply, Settings modal with quality-high/balanced/saver + toggle-animations/particles, and full Admin Studio (admin-email/password/login, upload-asset, toggle-live/featured/published, create-wallpaper). Preset chips (preset-clouds/petals/particles/lightRays) render conditionally only when 'toggle-live' is ON — correct. One data issue: the featured Temple demo wallpaper is missing from Mongo so 3 of 4 expected featured live wallpapers exist; Mahadev(clouds)/Krishna(petals)/Ganesh Ji(particles) are correct.

minor.issue: Featured Temple wallpaper (isFeatured=true, animationPreset='lightRays') is missing from the database. Only a non-featured 'Temple • Pratah Darshan 2' remains, so the lightRays preset has no live demo asset. Likely deleted during a prior test cycle; seed() only inserts when the collection is empty so it won't self-heal. Reinsert the featured Temple row or add an idempotent Phase 2 backfill.

issues: React-Native-Web deprecation warnings in console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Cosmetic only, does not affect Android native build.

action_items: Reinsert the featured 'Temple • Pratah Darshan' wallpaper (isFeatured=true, isLive=true, animationPreset='lightRays') so all four featured Phase 2 live presets have a demo asset. Consider making seed() idempotent per-row (upsert by name) instead of gating on collection count.
Optional: silence RN-Web deprecation warnings by migrating `pointerEvents` and `shadow*` styles in components (LinearGradient/Modal callers) — non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: Upload path is properly wired to Emergent Object Storage with lazy init + 503 re-init retry, 415 mime guard, 25MB size guard, and /api/files/{path} public read-through. Good.
Phase 2 backfill loop in seed() only patches docs missing `isLive`; safe for existing rows but cannot recreate deleted seed rows (see Temple issue).
server.py is 228 lines but very dense (multi-statement lines). Not a functional issue; slightly harder to review. Consider splitting admin router into a module in a later refactor.
Admin studio 'apply' flow is intentionally honest (does not claim success) — matches the requested Phase 2 native-build contract.

success_rate.backend: 93% (14/15 pytest cases, single failure is missing seed row, not a code defect)

seed_data_creation: Test uploaded a 1x1 PNG to Emergent Object Storage and created TEST_phase2_upload_wallpaper referencing the returned /api/files/... URL; the test then deleted the wallpaper via DELETE /api/admin/wallpapers/{id}. The uploaded object itself remains in Emergent Object Storage (no delete API used).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https://deity-live-launch.preview.emergentagent.com). Admin creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. The upload 503 bug is RESOLVED — do not regress. Preset chips in AdminStudio only render when toggle-live is ON; test by first flipping toggle-live then asserting preset-clouds/petals/particles/lightRays. Phase 2 native Android WallpaperService (plugins/withWallpaperService.js) cannot be exercised in Expo Go / web preview — do not fail on that.
rca_of_issue: P0 upload 503 bug: root cause was that /api/admin/uploads had no cloud target; fix now calls Emergent Object Storage via POST {STORAGE_URL}/init to fetch a storage_key (cached in module scope) and PUT /objects/{path} for the actual bytes, with automatic re-init on 503. Verified: multipart PNG upload returns 200 with {url:'/api/files/divyalive/uploads/<uuid>.png', path, contentType:'image/png', size}; GET /api/files/... returns byte-identical response with matching Content-Type. Bad mime (text/plain) is rejected with 415 as required. Missing-featured-Temple issue is a stale-data problem, not the upload bug.
